title: Portfolio Milestone Planner
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Capstone Portfolio
Project Planning
MicroSim Development Workflow
Quality Gates
description: A p5.js Gantt-style planner of the seven capstone milestones from Chapter 25. Sliders for the number of MicroSims, test participants and weeks available stretch the generation, instrumentation and testing bars; bars that finish after the deadline or whose gate is at risk turn amber with a one-sentence warning, and clicking a bar shows its deliverable and gate. Durations are illustrative estimates, not measured effort data.
audience: Teachers, instructional designers, learning-technology developers and learning-analytics practitioners (college undergraduate and professional development)

learningObjectives: The learner will design a week-by-week schedule for their own portfolio and identify which milestone gates put the schedule at risk.

accessibility.notes: Sliders have aria-labels; the chart is a Tab stop and the arrow keys select bars; at-risk bars are marked by a dashed outline and an exclamation mark as well as amber; describe() summarizes the whole schedule and the selected milestone

controls.label: Number of MicroSims
controls.purpose: Stretch or shrink the generation, instrumentation and testing bars

controls.label: Test participants
controls.purpose: Stretch or shrink the testing bar; fewer than 3 puts the usability gate at risk

controls.label: Milestone bars
controls.purpose: Open the deliverable, gate, estimate and warning for a milestone

simulation.model: Sequential milestone schedule with illustrative linear effort estimates
equations: test and review = 0.25 + 0.15 x participants + 0.06 x MicroSims weeks
plan, protect, evaluate, present = 1 week each
assumptions: Stages run one after another, as the chapter orders them
Estimates are calibrated only to reproduce the chapter's suggested 8-week schedule; they are not measured effort data

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Constraint-based design with immediate feedback on risk
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Parameter sliders driving a Gantt chart with clickable bars
keyQuestions: Which stages grow with the size of the portfolio?
Which gate falls past the deadline first when time is short?
What would you cut to make the plan fit?
commonMisconceptions: Adding MicroSims only adds generation time
Testing with one or two people is enough evidence
assessmentOpportunities: A schedule with no at-risk gates
Naming the gate most at risk and a mitigation
